title: Settings
interfaceHint: The language Lingora is shown in.
notesHint: Conversations are saved on your Mac so you can view, export or summarize them.
saveHint: Every time you translate, a note is created in Notes.
speakersMissing: An add-on is missing (~40 MB): download it in “Diagnostics and downloads” below.
speakersHint: Labels who is speaking in the notes: Person 1, Person 2… Processed on your Mac.
summaryLangHint: Note-taking summaries are written in this language. You can change it on each note.
keyKeychain: Key saved in the Mac keychain.
keyNone: No key. To summarize, Lingora sends the transcript to Groq with your own key; it is stored in the Mac keychain.
diagnosticsHint: What Lingora needs to listen, translate and speak.
aboutWithKey: Everything runs on your Mac, except the summaries you ask for: that transcript is sent to Groq.
aboutPrivate: Everything runs on your Mac: audio and text never leave your computer.
myNameHint: In notes, what you say into your microphone shows as "{label}".
